author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v2.3.0: time-window median filter for level/liquidDepthCm (default 30 s) to reject the scattered ultrasonic readings while the tank is filling; during changes it publishes only when the median moves past a deadband (default 2%) twice in the same direction, and publishes the exact median once readings settle; optional levelRaw attribute for diagnostics. v2.2.0: liquidDepthMax now means sensor-to-maximum-level distance (same as the cloud driver); single calibration command with the corrected formula.

x-catalog.description: Local driver for Tuya Wi-Fi ultrasonic tank level sensors (port 6668, protocols 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5), with no Tuya Cloud. Level, water column and alarm state, plus optional volume calculation.
